name: action-sheet
title: Action sheet
description: The mobile list of actions that rises from the bottom edge: large rows, a destructive row last, a separate Cancel, menu keys, and a narrow dialog on wide screens.
docs: actions are plain objects: label, icon (an element), onSelect, destructive, disabled and description. Destructive rows are moved to the end. The list is a menu: one tab stop, the arrow keys, Home, End and type-ahead; a disabled row stays reachable so its description can say why. Below 640px (breakpoint), and on any screen under 560px tall such as a phone held sideways, it is a Drawer, so a drag on the handle or a tap on the backdrop dismisses it; from 640px wide on a taller screen it is a narrow Dialog with the same list. In both the rows scroll when the screen is too short for them and the Cancel stays in view. With a trigger, focus goes back to it on close; without one (open with `open`) give focus back yourself in onOpenChange. For more than about seven choices use a menu or a list instead.
